title: Follow up qa-v1-theory-19a2eb620d6c4048cf817597
behavioral_concerns: follow up: Pending failure in durable CLI initiation leaks accepted run without terminal proposal when sprintRuntimeService fails

evidence.summary: beginDurableCLICommand accepts before sprintRuntimeService and Finish proposes terminal - durable_operations.go Accept/Finish and sprint_commands.go durable sites all call finishDurableCLICommand on sprintRuntimeService error

All six durable CLI initiation branches (flow, verify, execute, qa run/resume, review, smoke) return finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err) when sprintRuntimeService fails, preventing leaked Running run

Claim failure path in AcceptOperation returns without terminal proposal (prepared run leak) - distinct from sprintRuntimeService but shows persistence contract boundary; append failure does propose TerminalPersistenceLost

theories.claim: Durable CLI initiation leaks accepted run without terminal proposal when sprintRuntimeService fails after beginDurableCLICommand
theories.basis: beginDurableCLICommand in internal/app/durable_operations.go:49 creates a durable run via AcceptOperation (Accept+Claim+append Running event and starts control goroutine) before the caller in sprint_commands.go invokes sprintRuntimeService; a failure in sprintRuntimeService could leave the run in LifecycleRunning without a terminal proposal, violating contract-persistence-and-migrations requirement that accepted runs always reach a terminal proposal
theories.verification_surface: Read-only code inspection of internal/app/durable_operations.go AcceptOperation, durableCLICommand.Finish, FinishOperation, beginDurableCLICommand, finishDurableCLICommand and all durable CLI initiation sites in internal/app/sprint_commands.go (flow, verify, execute, qa run/resume, review, smoke) and internal/app/operation_runner.go sharedOperationRunner error paths
theories.confirmation_condition: Any path where beginDurableCLICommand succeeds (AcceptedOperation returned) then sprintRuntimeService returns error and the code returns without calling finishDurableCLICommand / FinishOperation / proposeRunTerminalWithRetry, leaving runcontrol Snapshot LifecycleRunning and LastSequence without terminal
theories.refutation_condition: Every durable CLI path that calls beginDurableCLICommand also on sprintRuntimeService error calls finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err) which joins and calls durableCLICommand.Finish -> durableOperationManager.FinishOperation -> proposeRunTerminalWithRetry with TerminalFailed/Cancelled/TimedOut, observable at internal/app/durable_operations.go:71 and internal/app/sprint_commands.go:242,297,343,436,515,571
theories.inconclusive_condition: If inspection cannot determine whether FinishOperation is invoked due to indirect control flow, or if repository/Claim failure leaves a Prepared run without terminal outside the sprintRuntimeService scope
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Inspect only assigned context_paths; cite line numbers; do not execute runtime; request bounded context expansion for runcontrol handler if needed; no file writes or shell invocations

theories.outcome_reason: Current codebase refutes the pending leak for the specific sprintRuntimeService failure: internal/app/durable_operations.go:49-60 beginDurableCLICommand returns AcceptedOperation only on success, durable_operations.go:71-84 Finish maps runErr to OperationFailed/TerminalFailed and proposes via proposeRunTerminalWithRetry, and every CLI durable site in sprint_commands.go that accepts then calls sprintRuntimeService on error immediately calls finishDurableCLICommand - flow:243-244, verify:297-299, execute:343-345, qa run:435-438 (including QAWriterToken error path 431-432), review:515-517, smoke:571-573, with final err = finishDurableCLICommand(durable, err) for the main execution. No CLI path was found that returns sprintRuntimeService error without finishing. A separate pre-existing leak remains for AcceptOperation Claim failure (durable_operations.go:116-119) which returns without terminal proposal, but that is outside the sprintRuntimeService scope of this concern.
